metadata.question: Regarding land use in the Guayas River delta, based on Landsat 8 imagery from August 29, 2024, is the area within a 1km radius of coordinates -2.306934, -79.887682 predominantly shrimp farming rather than mangrove forest?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) - Date: August 29, 2024 (single date or narrow window) - Location: Point at -2.306934, -79.887682, with 1km buffer 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking using QA_PIXEL band - This is about land use classification, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish: - Use spectral indices to differentiate: * NDVI: Mangroves typically have high NDVI (0.5-0.8) * NDWI/MNDWI: Shrimp ponds have high water content (positive values) * NIR/SWIR patterns differ significantly - Calculate mean values and pixel statistics - If NDWI is high and NDVI is moderate-low → shrimp farming - If NDVI is high and NDWI is low → mangrove forest - Valid Zero: Legitimate classification values (A/B) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or impossible values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.887682, -2.306934]); const roi = point.buffer(1000); // 1km radius const targetDate = '2024-08-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const landsat8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(targetDate, ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .sort('CLOUD_COVER'); const imageCount = landsat8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { // Try expanding date range const expandedCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2024-08-20', '2024-09-10') .sort('CLOUD_COVER'); const expandedCount = expandedCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Expanded search images: ${expandedCount}`); if (expandedCount === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 8 imagery available."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // Cloud masking function function maskL8sr(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); const saturationMask = image.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0); const opticalBands = image.select('SR_B.').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); return image.addBands(opticalBands, null, true) .updateMask(qaMask) .updateMask(saturationMask); } // 3. Processing const collection = imageCount > 0 ? landsat8 : ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate('2024-08-20', '2024-09-10') .sort('CLOUD_COVER'); const image = collection.first(); const masked = maskL8sr(image); const cloudCover = image.get('CLOUD_COVER').getInfo(); console.log(`Cloud cover: ${cloudCover}%`); // Calculate indices const nir = masked.select('SR_B5'); const red = masked.select('SR_B4'); const green = masked.select('SR_B3'); const swir1 = masked.select('SR_B6'); const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red)).rename('NDVI'); const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)).rename('NDWI'); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('MNDWI'); const indices = masked.addBands([ndvi, ndwi, mndwi]); // Check valid pixels const pixelCount = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after cloud masking."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation const stats = indices.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndviMean = stats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndwiMean = stats.get('NDWI').getInfo(); const mndwiMean = stats.get('MNDWI').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (ndviMean === null || ndwiMean === null || mndwiMean === null) { console.log("Calculation returned null values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (ndviMean < -1 || ndviMean > 1 || ndwiMean < -1 || ndwiMean > 1) { console.log("Invalid index values (out of range)."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`NDVI mean: ${ndviMean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`NDWI mean: ${ndwiMean.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`MNDWI mean: ${mndwiMean.toFixed(3)}`); // Classification logic: // Shrimp ponds: High MNDWI (>0.0), moderate NDVI (0.0-0.4) // Mangrove forest: High NDVI (>0.5), negative MNDWI (<-0.1) const isShrimp = mndwiMean > 0.0 && ndviMean < 0.5; const isMangrove = ndviMean > 0.5 && mndwiMean < 0.0; console.log(`Classification: Shrimp=${isShrimp}, Mangrove=${isMangrove}`); if (isShrimp && !isMangrove) { console.log("Area predominantly shrimp farming."); console.log("A"); } else if (isMangrove && !isShrimp) { console.log("Area predominantly mangrove forest."); console.log("B"); } else if (mndwiMean > -0.1 && ndviMean < 0.5) { console.log("Mixed/aquatic characteristics favor shrimp."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Area predominantly mangrove forest."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
